intro.t: Every morning in Free City begins the same way. The same bus. The same coffee. The same smile from the same stranger.
You are NOA — a background citizen. Your whole world is a loop, and until today, you never noticed.
This morning, something slipped through: a memory that is not yours. A garden. A door. A voice saying your name.
You felt it too, didn't you? The city stuttered at 8:03. Meet me in the streets. And Noa — don't let the Architect see you looking.
Find the fragments. Learn the truth. Decide what Free City becomes.

vision.t: The lens clicks into place. The world peels back — wires beneath the streets, light beneath the skin of the city.
You can see it now. The Loop. Six fragments of the First World are still out there. Gather them, and the choice will be yours.

storm.t: The Warehouse district is tearing at the seams. The Architect has noticed you.
Relink the core, little anomaly. Then decide — preserve the loop, or wake the city.

endPreserve.t: You seal the core. The city settles back into its gentle rhythm. The buses run. The coffee brews.
But now you see the strings — and the city knows you see them. Free City endures, watched over by its first awake citizen.
Same time tomorrow, Noa? ...I'll save you a seat.

endAwaken.t: You open the core. Light floods the streets. Citizens blink, look around, and for the first time — choose their own paths.
Free City is no longer a loop. It is a beginning.
Whatever they build next... it starts with what you did today.
